## Why this is a stacked draft
Expand the SAME PokeBank NX legality analyzer toward generations I–IX **in parallel** with Gen I–IV acceptance, rather than waiting for exhaustive older-generation parity. This branch targets coordinator PR #298; **do not merge accepted legality or MAIN** while its exact-head tests remain blocked.

## Real implementation
- New `Gen59FormatDomainEvidence.h` classifies existing native Gen VII–IX formats (LGPE, SWSH, BDSP, PLA, SV, ZA), using format-specific conservative National species upper bounds and explicitly unverified move ceilings.
- Production `Legality::analyze` now classifies native modern storage independently from save labels, applies modern format bounds, chooses mint/stat-nature checks from native storage, and explicitly marks history/structure coverage incomplete. Unknown/ambiguous source histories cannot produce a global historical Invalid.
- New bounded `Gen56NativeEnvelopeEvidence.h` for PK5 (136/220 bytes) and PK6 (232/260 bytes), with size-first safe header inspection and **NO false claim of decryption/checksum validation**.
- Native standalone C++ boundary regression, GCC/Clang normal plus ASan/UBSan workflow, and a fail-closed source wiring contract.

## Not yet implemented
**This does not claim full Gen IX legality or full PK5/PK6 decoding.** Gen V/VI decrypted entity readers, 3DS formats beyond LGPE, per-game encounters and moves, breeding/events, VC/Bank/HOME and generation-specific transfers, authentic retail historical witnesses, and full PKHeX parity remain staged work. Z-A's future/DLC National species ceiling remains unverified and therefore is not used for hard Invalid.

## Guardrails
Read-only input, no ROM/event archive copying, no source-save writes or Inject Save changes, no auto-fix. Keep original user saves immutable. Do not merge into PR #298/main without exact-head compile, normal native regression, sanitizer runs, and scope review.

## Validation
GitHub Actions is the required full-checkout execution environment; clone in this task environment has DNS failure. Until exact-head CI actually runs and passes, acceptance is blocked.

## Sequence after this foundation
1. PK5 read-only entity + checksum/decrypt plus original BW/B2W2 save evidence.
2. PK6 plus X/Y/ORAS 3DS read-only adapters.
3. PK7 SM/USUM and LGPE interoperability.
4. Gen VIII family (SWSH/BDSP/PLA) standalone authentic source rules.
5. Gen IX S/V + Z-A native encounter/moves and DLC revisions.
6. Historical transfer graph across Gen I–IX (Time Capsule, Pal Park, Poké Transfer, Bank, HOME).
7. Cross-game breeding/events/four-slot move legality and hard false-Invalid review.
8. PKHeX differential evidence, native fuzz/sanitizer certification and staged UI integration.

This draft is open for CI evidence only. Do not mark it ready or merge it.

- **PK6 codec.**
  - Decrypt67/Encrypt67 (block shuffle and LCG crypt) and the Add16 checksum.
  - Decoding is strict: unknown sizes, a nonzero sanity word and a bad checksum are rejected.
  - Decode then encode reproduces the original bytes exactly.
- **SAV6 parser.**
  - Tells XY from ORAS by the save size, the BEEF footer, every block's CRC16-CCITT and the MyStatus version byte.
  - Reads the Trainer (read-only), the Party and all 31×30 Boxes. Corrupt box records are quarantined and counted.
  - The ORAS demo save is explicitly unsupported.
- **Staged Edit / Clone / Remove.**
  - Edits are applied to an app-owned copy and checked by a separate verifier:
    - Only the staged record ranges may change, and within each record only the editable-field byte/bit mask.
    - Elsewhere, only the checksums of the owning blocks may change.
    - The result must strictly reparse as the same game.

  - The verifier allows changes only inside the pouch slot ranges and the owning block's CRC.
- **Read-only readouts.** Box names, unlocked/current box, and Pokédex seen/caught.
- **`Gen6ExactFormatEditorProvider`.**
  - Gives each PK6 field a state (Editable / ReadOnly / Derived / Hidden), per Box or Party record, for the one shared editor.

## PokeBank NX change summary

Thread 3, Gen VII lane, stacked on the Gen VI lane (#309). This draft exists for CI evidence only. It must never be marked ready or merged.

It adds a strict, read-only Sun/Moon and Ultra Sun/Ultra Moon SAV7 parser:
- **Identity:** the save is accepted only when all of these hold:
  - its size is 0x6BE00 (SM) or 0x6CC00 (USUM);
  - it has the BEEF footer;
  - every block's CRC16Invert is valid, with block 36 computed with the signature region cleared, as in PKHeX `ClearMemeCrypto`;
  - the MyStatus game version is SN, MN, US or UM.
- **Signature:** the MemeCrypto signature is verified with the vendored `FlagBrew/memecrypto` (RSA verify, and the payload must begin with the SHA-256 of the checksum table).
- **Contents:** Trainer (read-only), Party, and all 32×30 Boxes. PK7 records use the shared, cited Decrypt67 codec.
- **Editor and sources:** a read-only Gen VII editor provider, and sources using the same verified Checkpoint and Dekopon layouts as Gen VI. Azahar is unsupported.

**SAV7 export is explicitly unsupported.** PKHeX and PKSM-Core build the re-signed payload differently: PKHeX writes the hash followed by zeros, while PKSM-Core writes the hash followed by `reverseCrypt` of the cleared region. The parser reports the payload tail it observes, and one save written by the game itself will settle which is correct (see `docs/gen7/README.md`). Let's Go is a separate save family and is not part of this PR.

## Scope
- [x] PokeBank NX only. New files under `Integration/Gen7` plus one `include Makefile.host.gen7` line.
- [x] References are pinned: PKHeX `6501f0ab`, PKSM-Core `aa22d7a4`, memecrypto `bd3b16ee`, PKSM `9e18c806`. Nothing is taken from #301.

## Safety
- [x] There is no write path for SAV7 at all.
- [x] Only synthetic fixtures are committed. They are signed in-test with the vendored memecrypto.

## Verification
- [x] `test_gen7_save` (344 checks) passes under GCC 13 and Clang 18, and with ASan/UBSan (`detect_leaks=1`).
- [x] It is differential against PKSM-Core's `SavSUMO`/`SavUSUM` block tables and its `crc16`.
- [x] The full `make -f Makefile.host host-test` passes.
- [ ] Native `make -j1`: not run in this lane. `src/Integration/Gen7` is not in the native Makefile yet; that is requested from Thread 2.

Two defects in the vendored memecrypto are documented, each with the narrowest possible exemption:
- **Undefined behaviour:** a signed shift in `sha1.c:203`. Only the UBSan `shift-base` check is exempted, and only for the vendored objects.
- **Memory leak:** `rsa.c` never frees its temporaries. The leak suppression is scoped to `rsa_encrypt` and `rsa_decrypt` only.

## Known limitations / next step
- Next: PK7 staged editing on an app-owned copy, built up to the signing step. Export stays gated on the re-signing evidence.
- Not tested on a device.

## PokeBank NX change summary

This PR starts the Gen VIII lane (Thread 3), with Sword/Shield first. It follows the design in `docs/gen8/SWSH_RESEARCH.md`, which the coordinator approved. The branch starts from the Gen VII lane head `2438b5d`. Apart from one `include Makefile.host.gen8` line in `Makefile.host`, everything is a new file.

This draft is for CI evidence only. Do not mark it ready or merge it.

- **SwishCrypto + SCBlock container** (`Gen8SwishCrypto.h/.cpp`)
  - Decrypt is strict and runs in this order:
    1. Check the salted SHA-256 first.
    2. Remove the static xorpad.
    3. Read each block with its own per-key XorShift32 stream, accepting only known SCTypeCode types and array subtypes.
  - Decrypt also rejects:
    - a declared length that runs past the payload;
    - leftover bytes that don't form a whole block;
    - duplicate block keys.
  - Encrypt is the exact inverse: a decrypt followed by an encrypt reproduces the file byte for byte.
- **PK8 record codec** (`Gen8PK8.h`)
  - Decrypt8/Encrypt8 with 4×80-byte blocks, shuffled by the encryption constant.
  - Add16 checksum over [0x08, 0x148).
  - The sanity word must be zero.
  - Sword/Shield stores the full 0x158-byte party-format record in boxes too.
- **Strict `main` parse** (`Gen8Save.h/.cpp`)
  - Accepts only the 8 file sizes PKHeX lists for Sword/Shield (one per patch history).
  - MyStatus, Party and Box must be raw byte blocks of at least the cited length.
  - The version byte 44/45 maps to `sword_switch`/`shield_switch`.
  - Every party slot the save counts as filled must decode as a valid Pokémon.
  - All 32×30 box records are decoded. Records that fail decoding are counted and set aside, never overwritten.
  - Trainer data is read-only.
  - Battle-team slots and locks are read from `TeamIndexes8`/`TeamLocks`. If those blocks are missing or malformed, the later staged session will refuse Clone/Remove.

## Scope

- [x] Targets PokeBank NX, not PKSE upstream.
- [x] Unrelated refactors kept out. No shared file was changed except the allowed include line.
- [x] References and their roles:
  - PKHeX `6501f0ab46e8f8ca048539dbaf8cae8cb104e722` supplies every format constant.
  - PKSM-Core `aa22d7a4` (the existing submodule) is used only as a test-time differential.

## Safety

- [x] Live installed-game save writing stays hard-disabled. This lane has no mount, commit or inject path, and never calls a legacy `saveTrainerInfo*` writer. The workflow greps `Integration/Gen8` for those APIs and fails if any appear.
- [x] There are no controller or navigation changes.
- [x] Read-only sources stay read-only. The parser copies its input, and a test asserts that the input is unchanged afterwards.
- [x] Only synthetic fixtures are committed. They are generated in code under `tests/fixtures/gen8/*.h`, and CI fails if any non-header file appears there.

## Verification

- [x] `gen8-host-test` and `gen8-host-sanitize` pass with GCC 13 and Clang 18, including ASan/UBSan with `detect_leaks=1` (1,159 checks).
- [x] Differential checks against PKSM-Core:
  - xorpad and hash, via its `applyXor` and `sign`;
  - its `verify`;
  - its `getBlockList` (same keys and decrypted contents);
  - its PK8 block crypt, over 400 random records.
- [x] `git diff --check` passes.
- [ ] Full `make -f Makefile.host host-test` / `host-sanitize`: left to CI on this head.
- [ ] Native `make -j1`: not run. The Gen VIII sources are not in the native `Makefile`.

## Artifact identity

No `.nro` is produced.

## Documentation / tracking

- `docs/gen8/README.md` covers lane rules, status, references and decisions.
- `docs/gen8/integration-requests/01-export-companion-files.md` asks the owner of `Integration/Common` for an additive hook. With it, a verified export could carry `backup`/`poke_trade` through byte-identical.

## Known limitations / next step

- Next: staged PK8 Edit/Clone/Remove. Only touched blocks get re-encrypted, and a verifier compares the decrypted block set under a per-field byte mask. Export goes through `VerifiedStagedExport` into `exports/gen8`.
- After that: Legends: Arceus.
- BDSP stays read-only and unsupported until we can show which of its two save files is authoritative.
- Not tested on a device.

## PokeBank NX change summary

This is the single Gen I–IV finalization lane, built forward from PR #278's head `d0a45909`. Every later session continues on this PR. The progress checkpoint is `docs/handoffs/GEN14_FINAL_COMPLETION_PROGRESS.md`, and the owner's Switch checklist is `docs/handoffs/GEN14_HARDWARE_TEST_CHECKLIST.md`.

### Artwork regression (owner-reported)
- **Root cause:** `native-pr-build.yml` replaced `romfs/` wholesale with the older recovery snapshot. It never ran `fetch_product_art.py`, so its NROs had no region backdrops, trainer portraits, or Hisui/Paldea art.
- **Fix:** every NRO workflow now stages assets through `tools/prepare_release_romfs.sh`, which only fills gaps from the snapshot.
- **New guard:** `tools/verify_nro_romfs.py` parses the built NRO's ASET and RomFS tables. The build fails if any required asset is missing, or if any packaged file differs from local `romfs/`. Required assets are:
  - 10 region backdrops and 20 trainer portraits
  - 16 game covers
  - ball and type icons, fonts, and HOME sprites
  - the return host
- New `gen14-hardware-candidate.yml` builds one combined exact-head NRO. Its artifact records the application SHA, tree SHA, size and SHA-256, plus a packaged RomFS listing.

### Working-copy export and staged safety
- New generation-neutral verified export (`Integration/Common/VerifiedStagedExport`). Each export:
  - writes to a temp directory, fsyncs, reads back and checks SHA-256
  - strict-reparses the save before and after writing
  - publishes atomically and never overwrites an earlier export
  - never opens the source save for writing
- **Gen IV:** Review shows the original → staged slot list, and **X = Export Copy**.
- **Gen III:** **X = Export Copy**. Pending Bag edits are merged in by 4 KiB sector; if both workspaces changed the same sector, the export is refused.
- **Gen I/II and classic Bag exports:** moved onto the verified transaction, with exact-game strict validators.
- Review → Discard All now takes two steps: Y, then Y again. B keeps the edits.

### Save discovery and launch
- Gen IV discovery gives each provider root its own file budget and a per-directory entry cap. A large RetroArch folder can no longer starve DraStic or melonDS. The UI names whichever folder hit its limit.

## PokeBank NX change summary

A focused memory-safety fix in the Gen III legality engine. It was found during the #303 audit and kept separate from #303 on purpose.

**The bug**
- `addGen3PidEvidence` builds a named `Gen3NegaiBoshiEvent::Candidate` whose `std::u16string_view otName` comes from `pk.otName()`. That is a `std::u16string` temporary, destroyed at the end of the declaration.
- Both Negai Boshi template checks then compare against freed stack memory.
- **Evidence:**
  - ASan on GCC and Clang: `stack-use-after-scope` in `Gen3NegaiBoshiEvent::commonFields`.
  - Clang `-Werror` on this base already rejects the line: `Legality.cpp:450: object backing the pointer will be destroyed at the end of the full-expression [-Wdangling-gsl]`.
- **Triggering record:** a Japanese Negai Boshi Jirachi (Ruby, TID 30719 / SID 0, OT ネガイボシ, PID `F86484EA`, IVs 10/12/22/0/7/29).

**The fix** (one hunk in `src/Legality/Legality.cpp`)
- Copy the OT name into a local `std::u16string` that outlives the candidate.
- No rule, table, message or verdict changes.
- The other Gen III event templates pass `pk.otName()` inside a single call expression, where the temporary lives long enough. They are unchanged.

**Regression test** (`tests/test_gen3_legality_context.cpp`): the Negai Boshi record goes through `Legality::analyze`.
- It must match the pinned Negai Boshi template; a renamed OT must not match.
- On the unfixed base, the sanitizer build fails with the use-after-scope under both GCC and Clang. The normal build passes there only because the freed bytes happen to survive.

## PokeBank NX change summary

Gen IV Poké Ball, split out of #303 as the owner asked. A PK4's capture Ball belongs to the Pokémon, not to the save that holds it. `Pokemon4ReadOnlyView::ball()` now returns `max(0x83, 0x86)` in every container. That is the rule PKHeX uses (`G4PKM.Ball`, kwsch/PKHeX@6501f0ab) and the rule `Pokemon4Mutable::ball()` already used.

**Why max is right:** a PK4 has two Ball bytes.
- 0x83 is the Ball Diamond/Pearl/Platinum can display.
- 0x86 is written only by HeartGold/SoulSilver (catches, hatches, Pal Park) and holds the real Ball. For the Apricorn and Sport Balls, which D/P/Pt cannot show, 0x83 holds a Poké Ball stand-in.
- Every other origin, event gifts included, leaves 0x86 at zero.

So the larger byte is always the real Ball. PKHeX's own comment on `G4PKM.Ball` explains this ("return the higher of the two values").

**What was wrong:** the view read only the byte for the save that currently holds the record.
- A Diamond Poké Ball Pokémon in a HeartGold save read as Ball 0.
- A HeartGold Fast Ball or Sport Ball Pokémon in a Diamond or Platinum save read as a Poké Ball.
- The read-only view disagreed with the mutable editor model.
- Through `Legality::analyze`, the same HG/SS Bug-Catching Contest Kakuna lost its Sport Ball evidence when stored in a D/P/Pt save.

**Commits** (new commits on the integration base; #303 keeps its own commits unchanged):
- `146caac`: the `ball()` fix, the matching assertion in `test_gen4_bcc_multiretry_native_pk4`, and the new regression test.
- `b8eb006`: not part of the Ball change. The base fails `host-test` at `test_gen3_joint_egg_candidate.cpp:274` (also red on #298), and `make` stops at the first failure. This ports the existing test-only fix from 03693f7 unchanged so this PR's suite runs end to end.

- **17 origin families:** Diamond, Pearl, Platinum and HG/SS catches; all seven Apricorn Balls; Sport and Safari; D/P/Pt and HG/SS event gifts; Pal Park into D/P/Pt and into HG/SS.
- **Containers:** box and party records in D/P, Pt, HG/SS and unknown containers, and the mutable model. Also real checksum-valid Diamond/Pearl, Platinum and HG/SS saves parsed by `Gen4ReadOnlySave`, checking both a party slot and a box slot.

Expand the SAME PokeBank NX legality analyzer toward generations I–IX **in parallel** with Gen I–IV acceptance, rather than waiting for exhaustive older-generation parity. This branch targets coordinator PR #298; **do not merge accepted legality or MAIN** while its exact-head tests remain blocked.

Unknown/ambiguous source histories cannot produce a global historical Invalid.
- New bounded `Gen56NativeEnvelopeEvidence.h` for PK5 (136/220 bytes) and PK6 (232/260 bytes), with size-first safe header inspection and **NO false claim of decryption/checksum validation**.

**This does not claim full Gen IX legality or full PK5/PK6 decoding.** Gen V/VI decrypted entity readers, 3DS formats beyond LGPE, per-game encounters and moves, breeding/events, VC/Bank/HOME and generation-specific transfers, authentic retail historical witnesses, and full PKHeX parity remain staged work. Read-only input, no ROM/event archive copying, no source-save writes or Inject Save changes, no auto-fix. Keep original user saves immutable. Do not merge into PR #298/main without exact-head compile, normal native regression, sanitizer runs, and scope review.

GitHub Actions is the required full-checkout execution environment; clone in this task environment has DNS failure. Until exact-head CI actually runs and passes, acceptance is blocked.

1. PK5 read-only entity + checksum/decrypt plus original BW/B2W2 save evidence.

3. PK7 SM/USUM and LGPE interoperability.
